Next step · KYC

Share your business details.

After choosing products, review the document checklist and lease terms, then send your request to Revent. The team will confirm the secure channel for any documents it needs.

Documents to prepare

  • Emirates ID (EID)
  • Passport
  • Trade licence
  • Tax Registration Number (TRN)
  • Bank statement

Prepare these documents for Revent’s review. Please wait for Revent to request them through an appropriate channel. This form saves your contact details and selected plan, not identity documents. See Revent’s privacy policy.

Lease terms to review

  1. Once a lease begins, it must be completed for the full term. You may exit early by settling the difference amount stated in the final agreement. Revent will explain how that amount is calculated before you sign.
  2. Revent coordinates warranties and repairs covered under them. Where possible, and subject to inventory, Revent will provide a backup device to reduce downtime.
